skills.name: reach-ladder
skills.skill: async (b) => { const path = [[11,7],[11,6],[11,5],[11,4],[11,3],[11,2],[11,1]]; for (const [x,y] of path) { const r = await b.walkTo(x,y,'stand'); if (!r.ok) { b.log('walk fail '+x+','+y+' '+r.reason); } const p = await b.body(); if (p.x===11 && p.y===1) return; } }
skills.check: async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); return {ok: p.x===11 && p.y===1, detail: 'at '+p.x+','+p.y}; }

skills.name: fight
skills.skill: async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); const ms = await b.monsters(); let best=null, bd=1e9; for (const m of ms) { const d=Math.abs(m.x-p.x)+Math.abs(m.y-p.y); if (d<bd){bd=d;best=m;} } if (!best) return; await b.selectSlot(0); await b.faceAndPress(best.x,best.y,'ControllerX',0); }
